lyrics:
[Intro]
[00:01.28] We'll be here, lettin' go
[00:07.72] (Chopsquad)
[00:08.58] Someone needs to let me know
[00:12.78] I'm havin' problems lettin' go
[00:18.16] Overload (Hahaha)
[Chorus]
[00:25.74] I'm havin' problems lettin' go
[00:31.44] I need solutions, someone let me know
[00:38.34] I can't help it when I lose control
[00:44.58] This a emotional overdose
[Verse 1]
[00:51.74] I tried to talk but you ain't givin' feedback
[00:54.70] My depression really hungry and you feed that
[00:57.74] You say you love me, but I don't know if you mean that
[01:01.02] And I'm scared (Hahaha)
[01:04.86] You've been helpin' me avoid a relapse
[01:07.72] All your love and affection, I need that
[01:10.76] You prolly tired of me, yeah, I understand (Hahaha)
[01:17.54] I'ma make this song bleed, need a Kleenex
[01:20.64] Girl, you make me happy like a kid at recess
[01:23.66] But when you mad, you make me feel like a reject, no jerk
[01:30.58] You separate my angels from my demons
[01:33.18] Pinch myself 'cause it feels like I'm dreamin'
[01:36.24] But when you not here for me, the nightmares begin
[01:44.60] You might also like
[02:03.30] Emotional Overdose (Letting Go)
[Studio Session]
[02:12.64] Juice WRLD
[02:14.32] Big Foot (A Cappella)
[02:17.38] Nicki Minaj
[02:20.24] Push Ups
[02:26.10] Drake
[Chorus]
[02:33.84] I'm havin' problems lettin' go
[02:41.18] I need solutions, someone let me know (Hahaha)
[02:48.08] I can't help it when I lose control
[02:54.32] This a emotional overdose
[Verse 2]
[03:00.02] Huh, I cannot pretend that I don't care
[03:04.46] Hittin' below the belt, that shit hurt, and it's not fair
[03:07.88] Traumatized thoughts, girl, that shit gon' leave a mark, yeah
[03:13.06] Imagine takin' a bullet to the heart, yeah
[03:16.82] Nowadays, I don't know where home is
[03:21.68] But you're the closest thing to a home I have
[03:25.54] But right about now I feel homeless
[03:33.26] Back to the heartbreak flashbacks
[Chorus]
[03:42.22] I'm havin' problems lettin' go
[03:45.06] I need solutions, someone let me know
[03:47.90] I can't help it when I lose control
[03:49.86] This a emotional overdose
title: Emotional Overdose
author: Juice WRLD
